Chief_Complaint.content: Acute severe headache with visual changes, dizziness, nausea, and vomiting
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: acute severe headache with visual changes, dizziness, nausea/vomiting

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache started this morning about 4 hours ago with sudden onset
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Onset: started this morning ~4 hrs ago; sudden onset

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient initially described the headache as behind the eye then was uncertain
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: patient initially endorsed "behind the eye" then uncertain

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Headache is severe with patient rating pain 5–6 out of 10, with prior kidney stone pain as 10 for comparison
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Quality/severity: severe; patient rates ~5–6/10 (compared to prior kidney stone = 10)

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Associated photophobia with inability to tolerate screens
Vomited twice at onset of headache
Currently still nauseous and feels she may vomit again
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: currently still nauseous and feels she may vomit again
Prior similar episodes: none like this before

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Review of systems negative for weakness in arms or legs
Review of systems notes walking and gait are normal

Medications.content: Took paracetamol approximately 3 hours ago without relief
Medications.source_text: Meds: took paracetamol ~3 hrs ago — no relief

Assessment.content: Acute unilateral headache with visual aura and nausea/vomiting most consistent with migraine, first presentation
Assessment.source_text: 1) Acute unilateral headache with visual aura, nausea/vomiting — most consistent with migraine (first presentation)

Assessment.content: New severe headache requires reassessment if no response to initial therapy to exclude secondary causes
Assessment.source_text: 2) New severe headache — requires reassessment if no response to initial therapy to exclude secondary causes

Plan_of_Care.content: Trial ibuprofen plus an anti-emetic to be obtained from pharmacy
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Trial ibuprofen plus an anti-emetic (obtain from pharmacy)

Plan_of_Care.content: Use sugary or carbonated drink such as Coke for additional symptomatic relief
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Additional symptomatic measures: sugary/carbonated drink (eg, Coke)

Plan_of_Care.content: Rest as an additional symptomatic measure
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Additional symptomatic measures: sugary/carbonated drink (eg, Coke), rest

Plan_of_Care.content: Avoid screens as an additional symptomatic measure
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Additional symptomatic measures: sugary/carbonated drink (eg, Coke), rest, avoid screens

Plan_of_Care.content: Keep head still and limit movement as an additional symptomatic measure
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Additional symptomatic measures: sugary/carbonated drink (eg, Coke), rest, avoid screens; keep head still/limit movement

Plan_of_Care.content: If symptoms improve before scheduled assessment, patient should contact clinic to cancel appointment
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • If symptoms improve before scheduled assessment: contact clinic to cancel appointment

Plan_of_Care.content: If no improvement or if symptoms worsen or new focal neurological signs develop, arrange urgent in-person review with full neurological exam and further investigations as indicated
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • If no improvement or worsening/new focal neurological signs: arrange urgent in-person review with full neurological exam and further investigations as indicated

Plan_of_Care.content: Safety-net advice to contact clinic or attend emergency department for any new weakness, slurred speech, decreased consciousness, worsening headache, or progressive visual loss
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Safety-net: contact clinic/attend ED for any new weakness, slurred speech, decreased consciousness, worsening headache, or progressive visual loss

Follow_up_Information.source_text: If symptoms improve before scheduled assessment: contact clinic to cancel appointment

Follow_up_Information.content: If no improvement or worsening or new focal neurological signs, patient should have urgent in-person review with full neurological exam and further investigations as indicated
Follow_up_Information.source_text: If no improvement or worsening/new focal neurological signs: arrange urgent in-person review with full neurological exam and further investigations as indicated
